mapper.select: select `t1`.* from `user_course_hour_records` as `t1` inner join ( select `id`, row_number() over ( partition by `course_id` order by `updated_at` desc, `id` desc ) as `course_row` from `user_course_hour_records` where `user_id` = #{userId} ) as `ranked` on `ranked`.`id` = `t1`.`id` where `ranked`.`course_row` = 1 order by `t1`.`updated_at` desc, `t1`.`id` desc limit #{size};

SELECT * FROM `user_course_hour_records` as `t`
AND `t`.`user_id` = #{userId}
AND `t`.`is_finished` = #{isFinished}
ORDER BY `t`.`finished_at` ASC
ORDER BY `t`.`created_at` ASC
ORDER BY `t`.`updated_at` ASC
ORDER BY `t`.`real_duration` ASC
ORDER BY `t`.`id` ASC
ORDER BY `t`.`finished_at` DESC
ORDER BY `t`.`created_at` DESC
ORDER BY `t`.`updated_at` DESC
ORDER BY `t`.`real_duration` DESC
ORDER BY `t`.`id` DESC
LIMIT #{pageStart}, #{pageSize};

SELECT `a`.* FROM `user_course_hour_records` AS `a` INNER JOIN ( SELECT min(`created_at`) AS `min_created_at`, `course_id`, `user_id` FROM `user_course_hour_records` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} GROUP BY `user_id`, `course_id`) AS `b` ON `b`.`min_created_at` = `a`.`created_at` AND `b`.`course_id` = `a`.`course_id` AND `b`.`user_id` = `a`.`user_id`;

SELECT `a`.* FROM `user_course_hour_records` AS `a` INNER JOIN ( SELECT min(`created_at`) AS `min_created_at`, `course_id`, `user_id` FROM `user_course_hour_records` WHERE `course_id` = #{courseId} GROUP BY `course_id`, `user_id`) AS `b` ON `b`.`min_created_at` = `a`.`created_at` AND `b`.`course_id` = `a`.`course_id` AND `b`.`user_id` = `a`.`user_id`;

SELECT r.id AS record_id, r.course_id, c.title AS course_title, r.hour_id, h.title AS hour_title, h.type AS hour_type, r.finished_at FROM user_course_hour_records AS r INNER JOIN course_hour AS h ON r.hour_id = h.id INNER JOIN courses AS c ON r.course_id = c.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_finished = 1 AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC LIMIT #{pageStart}, #{pageSize};
